editorial:
You watch a huge train with toxic cargo speed away without anyone driving it. Veteran engineer Frank Barnes and young conductor Will Colson have to stop it before it hits a town. The movie feels like a ticking clock with lots of noise, speed, and danger. It keeps you on edge from start to finish, and the stakes feel real.

Denzel Washington and Chris Pine make a great team, and Tony Scott's direction makes every chase feel big and real. The action is loud and fast, though some scenes feel repetitive and the story is simple. You still get strong tension, good stunts, and a clear goal that keeps you invested. The ending lands well too. It is easy to follow. You will not get bored. If you like high-energy thrillers, this is a fun ride. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: You see Frank and Will chase the runaway train in another locomotive. They catch up, couple to it, and slow it down enough for Will to jump aboard. He applies the brakes, and the train stops just before a dangerous curve. The toxic cargo stays safe, the town is spared, and both men survive. Frank keeps his job, and Will earns respect after a rough start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-speed action and disaster thrillers.
